review.official:
A former
Columbian
auxiliary police officer who came to
Rhodes Island
to receive treatment after contracting
Oripathy
.
With her father's consent, she joined Rhodes Island as an operator, displaying above average talent in close combat and participating in various missions.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3%
Due to short infection duration, only small traces of infection are visible on the surface of the body. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.16u/L
Thanks to timely treatment and physical fitness, the current prognosis is optimistic. With regular treatment, there will not be much burden on the body.

An energetic Perro girl. 
She is always full of vigor and never remains down for long. As she acts friendly to everyone, she is well-liked by most operators and some older operators even treat her as a cherished sister or daughter. 
She enjoys regaling others with stories of her father's glorious deeds.

As everyone knows, most Infected are able to cast Arts without the help of an Arts Unit. 
On one hand, this is equivalent to using the Originium within one's body for casting Arts, which is likely to exacerbate one's Oripathy. On the other hand, mildly infected individuals like Jackie aren't able to channel much energy for Arts. 
For this reason, even Infected Casters often prefer to cast Arts through an Arts Unit whenever possible. Similarly, Rhodes Island provides an Arts Unit to every Caster operator. 
——In fact, the Engineering Department is very passionate about designing Arts Units of all shapes and sizes. One of their favorite pastimes is developing 'Arts Units' that look nothing like conventional units— and often don't work at all. 
The Arts Unit that hangs at Jackie's waist, gun-type Arts Unit PT-29, is the pride of the Engineering Department. 
Regrettably, even though Jackie applied for such an Arts Unit, it is only due to a habit formed while serving as an auxiliary police officer. Jackie herself is incredibly uninterested in the subject of Arts and her scores are very disappointing. Because of this, this Arts Unit is mostly an accessory to this day.

According to Jackie, her mother passed away from complications during her birth and she was single-handedly raised by her father. Jackie greatly reveres her father. 
She will happily describe in great detail how amazing of a policeman her father is, how many people he's helped and what accolades he's received. Some of her teammates can even recite her entire speech from beginning to end by heart now. 
Her story may be hyperbolic to some extent, but her father was still willing to bring his own infected daughter to Rhodes Island in person. Throughout his short stay in Rhodes Island, he never openly displayed any animosity towards the other Infected, and even remained agreeable to his daughter joining Rhodes Island after learning about some of Rhodes Island's more dubious activities. At the very least, he is not overly biased towards the Infected, even if he is just exercising self-restraint. That alone is already very rare amongst the non-Infected. 
Jackie's good manners and lively attitude in daily life is likely also a result of her father's teachings. 
From that perspective, her father is indeed a policeman worth respecting, and a good father.

Some people hold on to their hatred of the Infected even when they've become Infected themselves. Contrarily, some never hold much enmity towards the Infected, even while they're still uninfected. 
Jackie is one of those people. 
Perhaps as a result of her father's teachings, Jackie has never treated the Infected with hostility, unlike most other people. After overcoming her initial horror, she was able to quickly come to terms with her new identity as an Infected. 
It is possible that since she was showered in love from a young age, Jackie has a great capacity for love towards others——This can be considered a legitimate ability, as rare as it is. After coming to Rhodes Island, not only did this ability allow her to befriend others easily, it also gave her a new goal——To help the other Infected. 
Besides curing her Oripathy, she also wants to lend a hand to the other Infected. To her, it is only natural to do so.

The things we encounter and the people we meet often leave me with a sense of foreboding, afraid that our efforts towards a brighter future are all for naught. 
However, whenever I see a youngster like Jackie brimming with purity, kindness and vigor, I am reminded of my conviction: To guide these youngsters along the path of learning, so that they may gain more knowledge of the world, and help make it a better place. 
——Instructor Guericke's remarks towards Jackie in her Intermediate General Studies class

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, let me help!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor! You've been glued to that chair forever, and that's totally not good for you. Time for a quick workout session with me—stretch those muscles, replenish your energy. Trust me, you'll be able to work even better!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hey, hey, Doctor! She's here at Rhodes Island! Ah, her codename should be Dur-nar now. Anyway, she's incredible! I've literally only seen her in recruitment ads before! And she's such a nice lady! She gave me so many snacks, ehehe.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, I'm way more athletic than most people my age, you know. Let me show you a standing backflip! Watch closely! Hu-ya!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This gun? Oh, it's a gun-type Arts… Uh… What's that term again? Hmm… Right, Arts Unit! I applied for it out of habit after coming here, but honestly? I still prefer my fists over Arts.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've always known I'm lucky, but seeing the struggles of other Infected here at Rhodes Island… It's really opened my eyes. Doctor, tell me how I can help. I want to be useful.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Huh…? Oh, Doctor! I'm working on a letter to my dad. I've never told you about him? Then let me introduce him! He's the most incredible policeman ever! You've gotta hear all about his awesome stories!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Truth is, my dad's the one who recommended Rhodes Island. When he learned you could treat Oripathy, he was determined to get me here. Being apart from him is tough… I miss him so much. But I understand what matters most to him is seeing me healthy and safe.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You're almost as reliable as my dad, almost! In my book, you're the second most trustworthy person around, hehe! By the way, I've been telling my dad all about you in my letters, and now he's curious to meet you!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doc—! Ah, Doctor's asleep. Gotta be quiet…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor! I'm a new operator, codename Jackie! I used to be an auxiliary police officer in Columbia. Here's hoping we work well together!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Wow… This is even more awesome than what my dad could do!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Eh, am I getting promoted? Wow, that's awesome!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island's opened my eyes to so much… Maybe one day, I'll be just as amazing as my dad! Doctor, I promise I'll keep working hard, and I'm counting on your guidance!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm here!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll work hard!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's do our best!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Mission start!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor, is it my turn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Warm-up complete.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Time to show my skills!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Try a knuckle sandwich!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No trespassing!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Don't underestimate me!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Push it to the limit!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I thought they had us a few times there, but we did it! You're amazing, Doctor!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, Doctor, did you see how hard I worked!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, want me to chase after them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor. If only I'd put in more effort…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh… It's so big inside!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahhhh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hi, Doctor!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! This New Year, I'll be celebrating right here at Rhodes Island. Hehe, I've already written to dad, explaining how I'm learning to stand on my own, and how Rhodes Island is a place he can trust. Um, I do feel a bit lonely sometimes. But celebrating with my fellow operators makes up for it!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ah, it's Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor! Happy birthday! My dad always taught me birthdays are best spent doing something kind for others. So I'm thinking, how about we head to the kitchen? We can help the logistics operators with today's grocery delivery. Hehehe, who knows? We might just stumble upon some exciting surprises!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: 'Walk a mile in someone else's shoes before extending a helping hand.' Now I get why the Infected I met before didn't want to accept help or even talk much. I've learned a lot at Rhodes Island. When I return to Columbia, all this will help me become a better police officer.
